name: comp-255

frames.best_why: Knob is at the far right with the track fully filled and the field reading 100, the clearest full-range view.

tagline: Slide the bar or type a number in the little box on its right.
summary: A volume-style slider with a compact number field at its end. Dragging the knob fills the track and rewrites the field, and typing in the field moves the knob to match.
appearance: A small Volume label sits above a long grey track whose left portion is solid white behind a round white knob. A narrow rounded box at the right end of the row shows the same number in centred text.
behaviour: Dragging the knob grows the filled track and updates the box as it moves; typing a number and pressing Enter or leaving the box jumps the knob to that spot, and out-of-range text is corrected on blur.
demo_content: Label "Volume" on a 0 to 100 scale, starting at 25 and dragged up to 100 before settling at 60.
search_phrases: volume bar with a number box
slider and text field kept in sync
type a percentage or drag the knob
adjust a value out of one hundred
compact range control with a readout
set an exact number on a slider
horizontal fill bar with an input
use_when: Users mostly drag a quick value but sometimes need to type an exact number.
avoid_when: The number field is only about 56px wide, so long decimals or unit suffixes would clip.
customise: The label, minimum, maximum and starting value are written in the source; the field width and number format need edits.
weight_why: A single track and one small input, with no animation while idle.

a11y.note: Both controls have names, but they are generic: the field says Enter value rather than what it sets.

polish_why: Neat and legible, though it is essentially a plain slider with a stock input beside it.
title: Slider With Input
